blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解分析儀器確效（AIQ）的基本概念與其在品質資料生成中的基礎地位
blocks.en: Understand the basic concept of analytical instrument qualification (AIQ) and its foundational role in generating quality data

blocks.en: Master instrument classification: the criteria for Groups A/B/C and the corresponding depth of qualification

blocks.zh: 熟悉AIQ四個階段：DQ（設計確效）、IQ（安裝確效）、OQ（操作確效）、PQ（性能確效）的內容與順序
blocks.en: Become familiar with the four AIQ phases (DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ): their content and sequence

blocks.zh: 了解軟體確效（Software Validation）與儀器確效的整合方式
blocks.en: Understand how software validation is integrated with instrument qualification

blocks.en: Master the application of change control in instrument lifecycle management

blocks.en: Be able to design and execute a complete AIQ program in a CDMO laboratory environment

blocks.zh: Section 1: Introduction & Instrument Classification (Groups A/B/C) Section 1: 簡介與儀器分類（A/B/C 群組）
blocks.en: Section 1: Introduction & Instrument Classification (Groups A/B/C)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 儀器分類的實用判斷
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Practical Judgment in Instrument Classification

blocks.zh: 分類的核心問題是：「這台儀器的測量結果，直接影響到放行決定嗎？」
blocks.en: The core question in classification is: "Do this instrument's measurement results directly affect a release decision?"

blocks.zh: Group A（觀察即可）：攪拌器、離心機（一般用途）、超音波清洗機 — 只要確認它「在動」就夠了
blocks.en: Group A (observation is enough): stirrers, general-purpose centrifuges, ultrasonic cleaners. It is enough to confirm that the instrument is running.

blocks.zh: Group B（校正即可）：pH計、天平、水浴槽、烤箱、溫度計 — 需要定期校正、記錄校正證書
blocks.en: Group B (calibration is enough): pH meters, balances, water baths, ovens, thermometers. These need periodic calibration and retained calibration certificates.

blocks.zh: Group C（完整AIQ）：HPLC、GC、質譜儀、UV分光光度計、卡氏水分儀、粒度儀 — 需DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ全套
blocks.en: Group C (full AIQ): HPLC, GC, mass spectrometers, UV spectrophotometers, Karl Fischer titrators, particle size analyzers. These need the full DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ package.

blocks.zh: 注意：同一型號儀器在不同用途下可能分屬不同Group。例如天平用於一般稱重 = Group B；用於稱取基準物質進行標準品配製 = 可能需要Group C的管理。
blocks.en: Note: the same instrument model may fall into different groups depending on its use. For example, a balance used for general weighing = Group B; a balance used to weigh reference material for standard preparation may require Group C-level control.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 儀器確效的「駕照制度」
blocks.en: Analogy: AIQ as a "Driver's License System"

blocks.zh: 把AIQ想成汽車的駕照制度：摩托車（Group A，簡單）→ 普通駕照就夠了；轎車（Group B，中等）→ 需要定期年檢；大型拖車（Group C，複雜）→ 需要特殊駕照 + 定期檢驗 + 行車記錄器。儀器越複雜、用途越關鍵，所需的「資格認證」就越完整。
blocks.en: Think of AIQ as a driver's license system. A motorcycle (Group A, simple) needs only a regular license; a car (Group B, moderate) needs a periodic roadworthiness inspection; a heavy trailer (Group C, complex) needs a special license, periodic inspection and a trip recorder. The more complex the instrument and the more critical its use, the more complete the "credentials" it requires.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 同類儀器可跨Group
blocks.en: Key Notes: Instruments of the Same Type Can Fall into Different Groups

blocks.zh: USP明確指出「同類型儀器可能落在不同Group」。一台離心機若只用來分離固液（Group A），若加裝溫控系統且溫度影響測試結果，可能需要Group B管理。在新儀器採購/引進時，AIQ團隊必須基於實際預期用途進行分類，並形成書面文件說明分類依據。
blocks.en: USP states explicitly that "the same type of instrument may fall into different groups". A centrifuge used only to separate solids from liquids is Group A; if it is fitted with temperature control and temperature affects test results, it may need Group B control. When a new instrument is purchased or introduced, the AIQ team must classify it based on its actual intended use and document the rationale for the classification in writing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室有哪些儀器？請嘗試將它們分類為Group A/B/C，並說明理由。
blocks.en: What instruments does your laboratory have? Try classifying them as Group A/B/C and explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 如果一台原本用於Group B的pH計，開始用於校準標準曲線的配製，其分類應如何調整？
blocks.en: If a pH meter originally used as Group B starts to be used to prepare solutions for calibration curves, how should its classification be adjusted?

blocks.zh: Section 2: Components of Data Quality — The Quality Triangle Section 2: 數據品質要素 — 品質三角
blocks.en: Section 2: Components of Data Quality — The Quality Triangle

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 品質金字塔的層次邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Layered Logic of the Quality Pyramid

blocks.zh: USP描述的「品質三角形」從底層到頂層：
blocks.en: The USP "quality triangle" runs from the bottom layer to the top:

blocks.zh: 底層（AIQ）：儀器本身要合格 — 「工具可靠」
blocks.en: Bottom layer (AIQ): the instrument itself must be qualified. "The tool is reliable."

blocks.zh: 第二層（方法驗證）：分析方法要經過驗證 — 「方法可靠」
blocks.en: Second layer (analytical method validation): the analytical method must be validated. "The method is reliable."

blocks.zh: 第三層（系統適用性）：每次分析前的系統確認 — 「當下可靠」
blocks.en: Third layer (system suitability): the system is verified before each analysis. "The system is reliable right now."

blocks.zh: 頂層（QC樣品）：分析過程中的持續監控 — 「過程可靠」
blocks.en: Top layer (QC samples): ongoing monitoring during the analysis. "The process is reliable."

blocks.zh: 任何一層出問題，最終的分析結果都不可信。AIQ是整個品質架構的地基，地基不穩，上面建什麼都白費。
blocks.en: If any layer fails, the final analytical result cannot be trusted. AIQ is the foundation of the whole quality structure; if the foundation is not stable, nothing built on top of it is worth anything.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 航空安全的多重防護
blocks.en: Analogy: The Multiple Layers of Protection in Aviation Safety

blocks.zh: 這四個層次就像飛機的多重安全系統：AIQ = 飛機出廠前的適航認證；方法驗證 = 飛行員的飛行執照；系統適用性 = 起飛前的飛行前檢查；QC樣品 = 飛行途中的儀表監控。缺少任何一層，雖然飛機可能仍然飛行，但系統性風險大幅增加。
blocks.en: These four layers are like an aircraft's multiple safety systems: AIQ = the airworthiness certification before the aircraft leaves the factory; method validation = the pilot's license; system suitability = the pre-flight check before takeoff; QC samples = instrument monitoring during the flight. Without any one layer the aircraft may still fly, but the systemic risk rises sharply.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — AIQ與方法驗證的時序
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Sequence of AIQ and Method Validation

blocks.zh: AIQ必須在方法驗證之前完成。邏輯是：你不能用一台沒有確效的儀器去驗證一個分析方法，因為你不確定得到的數據是代表方法本身的表現，還是儀器的問題。在CDMO的技術移轉項目中，這個順序尤其重要：儀器IQ/OQ/PQ完成 → 才能啟動方法驗證或方法轉移驗證。
blocks.en: AIQ must be completed before method validation. The logic is that you cannot validate an analytical method on an instrument that has not been qualified, because you cannot tell whether the data reflect the performance of the method or a problem with the instrument. In CDMO technology transfer projects this sequence is especially important: instrument IQ/OQ/PQ is completed first, and only then can method validation or method transfer validation begin.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在CDMO接受客戶技術移轉時，建立「儀器確效狀態矩陣」：列出所有相關儀器 × 確效狀態（DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ完成/未完成）× 最後確效日期 × 下次PQ到期日。這個矩陣是決定「哪些儀器可以立即用於移轉方法驗證」的依據，也是客戶稽查時的重要展示資料。
blocks.en: When a CDMO receives a technology transfer from a client, build an "instrument qualification status matrix": list all relevant instruments × qualification status (DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ completed or not) × date of last qualification × next PQ due date. This matrix is the basis for deciding which instruments can be used immediately for transfer method validation, and it is also important material to present during client audits.

blocks.zh: Section 3: AIQ Process — Design Qualification (DQ) & Installation Qualification (IQ) Section 3: 分析儀器確效（AIQ）流程 — 設計確效（DQ）與安裝確效（IQ）
blocks.en: Section 3: AIQ Process — Design Qualification (DQ) & Installation Qualification (IQ)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — URS是AIQ的起點
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The URS Is the Starting Point of AIQ

blocks.zh: 用戶需求規格（URS）是整個AIQ的「設計藍圖」。寫好URS，後續所有確效測試才有依據。URS應包含：
blocks.en: The user requirements specification (URS) is the "design blueprint" for the whole AIQ. Only when the URS is well written do all subsequent qualification tests have a basis. The URS should include:

blocks.zh: 預期用途（例如：用於原料藥含量測定的HPLC）
blocks.en: Intended use (for example: an HPLC used for drug substance assay)

blocks.zh: 技術要求（波長範圍、流量精確度、偵測靈敏度等）
blocks.en: Technical requirements (wavelength range, flow rate accuracy, detection sensitivity, etc.)

blocks.zh: 環境要求（溫濕度、電源規格、空間）
blocks.en: Environmental requirements (temperature and humidity, power specifications, space)

blocks.zh: 法規合規要求（21 CFR Part 11、GxP等）
blocks.en: Regulatory compliance requirements (21 CFR Part 11, GxP, etc.)

blocks.zh: 供應商支援要求（技術服務、備品可及性）
blocks.en: Supplier support requirements (technical service, spare parts availability)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — DQ/IQ就像購屋與驗屋
blocks.en: Analogy: DQ/IQ Are Like Buying a House and Inspecting It

blocks.zh: DQ = 購屋前的需求評估與規格書（幾房幾廳、格局要求、地段條件）；IQ = 交屋時的驗屋（門窗是否安裝正確、水電是否接通、設備是否如規格書所示）。OQ/PQ則是入住後的使用測試（空調是否正常運作、噪音是否在可接受範圍）。跳過DQ就像沒有需求規格就簽約，最後拿到的房子可能完全不符合需要。
blocks.en: DQ = the needs assessment and specification before buying a house (number of rooms, layout requirements, location conditions); IQ = the inspection at handover (are the doors and windows installed correctly, are water and electricity connected, does the house match the specification). OQ/PQ are the usage tests after moving in (does the air conditioning work properly, is the noise within an acceptable range). Skipping DQ is like signing a contract without a requirements specification: the house you end up with may not meet your needs at all.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — IQ必要文件清單
blocks.en: Checklist: Required IQ Documents

blocks.zh:
IQ文件包套（IQ Documentation Package）：

1. 到貨確認單（Delivery Receipt）
   - 儀器型號 / 序號 ✓
   - 軟體版本號 ✓
   - 附件完整性 ✓
   - 外觀無損壞 ✓

2. 安裝記錄（Installation Record）
   - 安裝地點 / 環境條件（T, RH, 電壓）
   - 安裝人員（含資格）
   - 初始診斷結果

3. 軟體/網路設置
   - 軟體安裝日誌
   - 網路連接確認
   - 稽核軌跡功能確認

4. IQ執行報告（含結論和核准簽名）
blocks.en:
IQ Documentation Package:

1. Delivery Receipt
   - Instrument model / serial number ✓
   - Software version number ✓
   - Completeness of accessories ✓
   - No visible damage ✓

2. Installation Record
   - Installation location / environmental conditions (T, RH, voltage)
   - Installer (including qualifications)
   - Initial diagnostic results

3. Software/Network Setup
   - Software installation log
   - Network connection confirmation
   - Audit trail function confirmation

4. IQ execution report (with conclusion and approval signatures)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 供應商文件的審核責任
blocks.en: Key Notes: Responsibility for Reviewing Supplier Documents

blocks.zh: 供應商提供的IQ文件包套（如FAT報告、出廠測試報告）可以「滿足部分IQ要求」，但使用者仍有責任審核這些文件是否符合自己的要求。不能直接把供應商文件歸檔就算完成IQ。審核重點：測試參數是否涵蓋URS要求？測試環境是否代表實際使用環境？
blocks.en: The IQ documentation package provided by the supplier (such as the FAT report or factory test report) can "satisfy part of the IQ requirements", but the user remains responsible for reviewing whether these documents meet the user's own requirements. Simply filing the supplier documents does not complete the IQ. Review focus: do the test parameters cover the URS requirements? Does the test environment represent the actual use environment?

blocks.zh: 如果你正在引進一台新的HPLC系統，你的URS應該包含哪些技術規格？
blocks.en: If you are introducing a new HPLC system, what technical specifications should your URS include?

blocks.zh: 儀器到貨時發現外箱輕微凹陷但儀器外觀完好，你應如何記錄和處理？
blocks.en: On delivery you find that the outer carton has a slight dent but the instrument itself looks undamaged. How should you document and handle this?

blocks.zh: Section 4: Operational Qualification (OQ) & Performance Qualification (PQ) Section 4: 運作確效（OQ）與效能確效（PQ）
blocks.en: Section 4: Operational Qualification (OQ) & Performance Qualification (PQ)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — OQ vs. PQ的本質區別
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Essential Difference Between OQ and PQ

blocks.zh: 這是最常混淆的概念之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most commonly confused concepts:

blocks.zh: OQ：測試儀器「能做什麼」— 符合製造商規格，通常用標準品或模擬條件測試，一次性（但重大改變後需重複）
blocks.en: OQ: tests what the instrument "can do". It demonstrates conformance to the manufacturer's specifications, usually with reference standards or simulated conditions, and is essentially a one-time activity (repeated after major changes).

blocks.zh: PQ：測試儀器「在我們的用途下是否持續做得好」— 符合用戶需求，用實際樣品或接近實際的條件，持續進行
blocks.en: PQ: tests whether the instrument "continues to perform well for our intended use". It demonstrates conformance to the user's requirements, using actual samples or near-actual conditions, and is ongoing.

blocks.zh: 比喻：OQ = 新車出廠的性能測試（0~100km/h加速幾秒）；PQ = 你每次開車前的例行檢查（油表、胎壓、機油）
blocks.en: Analogy: OQ = the performance test of a new car at the factory (how many seconds from 0 to 100 km/h); PQ = the routine check you do before each drive (fuel gauge, tire pressure, engine oil).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — PQ就像定期健康檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: PQ Is Like a Regular Health Checkup

blocks.zh: 儀器的PQ就像人的定期健康檢查：不是因為儀器「生病了」才做，而是定期確認它「仍然健康」。頻率依據「風險」決定：高齡（老儀器）、使用頻繁（高負擔）、檢測關鍵參數（高風險用途）→ 健檢頻率更高。每次PQ都要建立記錄，累積的PQ歷史就是儀器的「健康履歷」，可用於趨勢分析和預測性維護。
blocks.en: Instrument PQ is like a person's regular health checkup: it is not done because the instrument is "sick", but to confirm periodically that it is "still healthy". The frequency is determined by risk: an older instrument, heavy use (high workload), or measurement of critical parameters (high-risk use) means a higher checkup frequency. A record is created for every PQ, and the accumulated PQ history becomes the instrument's "health record", which can be used for trend analysis and predictive maintenance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 定期審查（Periodic Review）的必要性
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Need for Periodic Review

blocks.zh: USP特別提到「關鍵儀器應有定期審查（periodic review）」。審查內容：確效/驗證狀態是否仍有效？用戶程序是否最新？變更控制記錄是否完整？系統產生記錄是否正確完整？電子記錄備份與恢復是否正常？這個審查通常每年一次，是品質系統的一部分，而非只是儀器部門的任務。
blocks.en: USP specifically notes that "critical instruments should have periodic review". The review covers: is the qualification/validation status still valid? Are the user procedures current? Are the change control records complete? Are the system-generated records correct and complete? Do electronic record backup and restore work properly? This review is usually done annually and is part of the quality system, not just a task for the instrument department.

blocks.zh: 在CDMO無菌產品的QC實驗室，HPLC用於原料藥含量測定（關鍵放行測試）。建議PQ頻率：每季度一次性能核查（使用標準品測試系統精確度、重現性）；每次使用前進行系統適用性測試（SST）作為日常確認。這種分層式確效策略（PQ + SST）既滿足法規要求，又有效控制確效工作量。
blocks.en: In the QC laboratory of a CDMO handling sterile products, an HPLC is used for drug substance assay (a critical release test). Suggested PQ frequency: a performance check once per quarter (using reference standards to test system precision and repeatability), plus a system suitability test (SST) before each use as the routine verification. This tiered qualification strategy (PQ + SST) both satisfies regulatory requirements and effectively controls the qualification workload.

blocks.zh: Section 5: Roles, Responsibilities, Software Validation & Change Control Section 5: 角色、職責、軟體驗證與變更控制
blocks.en: Section 5: Roles, Responsibilities, Software Validation & Change Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 使用者才是AIQ的責任主體
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The User Is Responsible for AIQ

blocks.zh: USP明確指出：儀器的確效責任在於用戶（User），而非製造商或供應商。這與很多人的認知不同——不是說「設備商做好IQ/OQ就算了」。即便聘用外部服務商執行確效，用戶仍需：審核確效計劃是否符合URS → 參與或監督執行過程 → 審核並批准確效報告 → 對確效結論負責。品質部門的角色是確保合規性，而非替代用戶執行確效。
blocks.en: USP states explicitly that responsibility for instrument qualification lies with the user, not the manufacturer or supplier. This differs from what many people assume: it is not the case that "the equipment vendor has done the IQ/OQ, so we are done". Even when an external service provider is engaged to perform the qualification, the user must still: review whether the qualification plan meets the URS, then participate in or oversee execution, then review and approve the qualification report, and take responsibility for the qualification conclusions. The role of the quality unit is to ensure compliance, not to replace the user in performing the qualification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 軟體確效的「三種廚師」
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Three Kinds of Cooks" in Software Validation

blocks.zh: 軟體分類就像餐廳的三種廚師模式：Non-configurable = 買便當（菜單固定，廠商負責品質）；Configurable = 半成品料理包（框架固定，但你可以調整鹹淡）；Custom-coded = 從頭自己料理（完全自主，但品質完全自負）。客製化程度越高，驗證工作量越大，自己對品質負的責任也越多。
blocks.en: Software categories are like three restaurant cooking models: Non-configurable = buying a boxed lunch (fixed menu, the vendor is responsible for quality); Configurable = a semi-prepared meal kit (fixed framework, but you can adjust the seasoning); Custom-coded = cooking from scratch (full control, but you are fully responsible for quality). The higher the degree of customization, the greater the validation effort and the more responsibility you carry for quality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 變更控制的觸發條件
blocks.en: Key Notes: Triggers for Change Control

blocks.zh: 以下情況必須啟動儀器變更控制：更換零件（尤其是關鍵部件如HPLC柱溫箱、偵測器）；軟體/韌體版本升級；儀器搬遷至新地點；重大維修後；使用用途改變（如增加新的測試方法類型）。有些看似「例行維護」的工作，如果替換的零件型號改變，也可能需要啟動變更控制，不能因為是小事就繞過流程。
blocks.en: Instrument change control must be initiated in the following situations: replacement of parts (especially critical components such as the HPLC column oven or detector); software/firmware version upgrades; relocation of the instrument to a new location; after major repairs; and a change of intended use (for example, adding a new type of test method). Some work that looks like "routine maintenance" may also require change control if the replacement part has a different model, and a change cannot be bypassed on the grounds that it is minor.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠HPLC的OQ/PQ文件是由供應商提供的嗎？你的QA部門有審核這些文件嗎？
blocks.en: Were the OQ/PQ documents for your site's HPLC provided by the supplier? Does your QA department review these documents?

blocks.zh: 如果HPLC的資料處理軟體進行了版本更新，你應該採取哪些確效步驟？
blocks.en: If the HPLC data processing software is updated to a new version, what qualification/validation steps should you take?

blocks.zh: 一台儀器從一個實驗室搬到另一個實驗室，需要重新進行哪些確效活動？
blocks.en: When an instrument is moved from one laboratory to another, which qualification activities must be repeated?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 儀器分類（Group A/B/C）：依據複雜度和測量重要性分類，決定確效深度。同一儀器可能因用途不同而落在不同分組。
blocks.en: Instrument classification (Groups A/B/C): classification is based on complexity and the criticality of the measurement, and determines the depth of qualification. The same instrument may fall into different groups depending on its use.

blocks.zh: 品質資料四要素：AIQ（地基）→ 方法驗證 → 系統適用性測試 → QC樣品 — 缺一不可。
blocks.en: Four components of data quality: AIQ (foundation) → method validation → system suitability testing → QC samples. None can be omitted.

blocks.zh: AIQ四階段：URS → DQ → IQ → OQ → PQ — 順序不可顛倒，各有明確文件要求。
blocks.en: Four AIQ phases: URS → DQ → IQ → OQ → PQ. The sequence cannot be reversed, and each phase has clear documentation requirements.

blocks.zh: OQ vs. PQ：OQ是「能做什麼」的功能確認（一次性為主）；PQ是「持續做得好」的性能確認（持續進行）。
blocks.en: OQ vs. PQ: OQ is the functional confirmation of what the instrument "can do" (mainly one-time); PQ is the performance confirmation that it "continues to perform well" (ongoing).

blocks.zh: 責任主體：用戶（User）對AIQ結果負最終責任；品質單位確保合規性；供應商提供支援但不替代用戶責任。
blocks.en: Responsibility: the user has ultimate responsibility for AIQ results; the quality unit ensures compliance; the supplier provides support but does not replace the user's responsibility.

blocks.zh: 軟體確效：韌體隨硬體確效；控制/採集/處理軟體依客製化程度決定驗證深度。
blocks.en: Software validation: firmware is qualified together with the hardware; the validation depth for control/acquisition/processing software depends on the degree of customization.

blocks.zh: 變更控制：任何對已確效儀器的改動必須經過評估，決定是否需要重新確效及其範圍。
blocks.en: Change control: any change to a qualified instrument must be assessed to decide whether requalification is needed and what its scope should be.
